== Description ==

[[Brandon Baity]] (standing far left, olive zip hoodie over beige collar), [[Jack Douglass]] (standing far left, blue beaver-logo tee, glasses, hair bun), [[Joe Horbey]] (standing center-left, dark cap, moustache, dark button-down), [[Logan Pietig]] (standing center-left, black UWL hoodie, black Nike shorts), [[Garrett Larson]] (back center-left, pink cap, long beard, black tee), [[Chris Wirfs]] (standing center-right, black tee, red shorts (back)), [[Chris Schoenthal]] (standing center-right facing left, black SWCCG cap, long ginger beard), [[Steve Harpster]] (standing right-center facing left, white hair, black jacket), and [[Benji Chu]] (standing far right, navy Yankees tee, black SWCCG cap, Crocs) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
